content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://hazaribag.dcourts.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Hazaribag Driver recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Driver post at DLSA Hazaribag is 12th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Driver post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Driver post announced by the District Legal Services Authority Hazaribag.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications for the Driver position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a valid Driving License (LMV/Transport), sufficient driving experience, good character, and be physically fit.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the DLSA Hazaribag Driver job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Interested candidates need to send their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Driver post?
faq.answer: The salary includes the minimum daily wage as per Jharkhand Government norms plus an additional Rs. 100 per day for fooding costs.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Driver role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application scrutiny and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of DLSA Hazaribag, the link for which is provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual or permanent job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity with the District Legal Services Authority Hazaribag.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for DLSA Hazaribag?
faq.answer: The official website for the District Legal Services Authority Hazaribag is https://hazaribag.dcourts.gov.in.
